verdict.rationale: Pylon documents an official Pylon MCP Server that exposes Pylon data to MCP-compatible AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor), authenticated via OAuth, allowing agents to read/update issues, accounts, and contacts, and this is corroborated by a docs probe confirming the page exists. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party confirmation of the MCP server working in practice and more detail on setup/config beyond the docs description.
